program_rates.note: Browsing many symbols runs many familywise tests, so about 5 in 100 symbols clear their own null by chance alone. These are the program-level rates over the whole covered set, published so a single symbol's result can be read against them.

disclosures.survivorship: The covered set is built from today's price store, so names that were delisted, acquired, or renamed are absent. That makes the covered set look healthier than the real historical market. Nothing on this page ranks symbols against each other, so the bias does not enter any per-symbol number.
disclosures.price_adjustment: Split- and dividend-adjusted closes are the vendor's CURRENT vintage re-applied to all history. This is not a frozen point-in-time adjustment: a very old year can read slightly differently than it did at the time.
disclosures.no_ranking: This artifact set carries no score, rank, or cross-symbol ordering.
